tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Find local businesses in all 50 states and the District of Columbia by trade, problem, name and place, nearest first. Understands problems as the trade that fixes them ('no heat' = HVAC, 'overflowing toilet' = plumbers, 'car won't start' = towing). Returns 20 results a page with phone, address, webs

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: One business in full: phone, address, website, opening hours and whether it's open now, holiday hours, emergency calls, services, towns it serves, state license numbers and expiry, and whether the owner has claimed the listing. Give either the id from search_businesses or a TownIndex page url.

tools.name: on_call_near
tools.description: Emergency service businesses whose owner has switched on 'on call' right now (for a few hours at a time), nearest first, within a distance of a ZIP code or a point. Few owners use it yet: when none is on call, use search_businesses with emergency_now, which also covers posted 24/7 emergency service.

tools.name: report_listing_issue
tools.description: Tell TownIndex that a listing is wrong: the business closed or moved, or its phone, hours or website are wrong. A person reviews every report before anything changes. findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_businesses" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
